title: Q3
description:
Read: 1Sa 15:22-23, Psa 40:6-8

To obey is better than sacrifice, and rebellion is as iniquity. The scroll already has the speaker's name, and he delights to do the will.

a) He takes away the first to establish the second. What is the first, if sacrifice is not being called evil, and a will is already written in the scroll?
